proves.claim: Separate short read commands (show, list, whoami) from a claimed seat each renew its presence, so the seat-gone sweep keeps a claim whose seat runs one command every 60 s.

cli.io-cli-main-run.short-commands-keep-.why: Without it, a regression where reads stop beating would again release the claim of any agent driving the board one SSH command at a time two minutes after its last write.

proves.claim: A claimed seat that runs no command for 3 minutes is returned by the same sweep as seat-gone.

cli.io-cli-main-run.quiet-seat-loses-cla.why: Without it, a regression that kept every claim alive would pass the first case while dead seats held their claims forever.

proves.claim: A command run through main() with an injected clock stamps the seat's presence beat with that clock's time, not the wall clock's.

cli.io-cli-main-run.beat-reads-command-c.why: Without it, a beat stamped by the wall clock lands in a fake-clock board's future, so a killed holder never looks gone and its claim never lapses (the liveness claim-step journeys went red on main).
